name: Aero-Weevil
journal_prompt: A beetle with a long snout that drills into the tough, gas-filled gourds to lay its eggs inside.
placement_note: Lives on the floating islands. `sky_island` and its neighbours are real canon biomes but are not renderable yet, so the export holds this as lore until a sky mode exists. This is a stated home, not an untagged entity.
